method: read-only source census; no runtime instrumentation or production changes
scope: serialized Reference backend optional persistent state, per-interval optional forcing/work allocations, and request-gated thermal carrier sample buffers

findings.persistent_state: fmr_b110_physical_state_t%snow is allocatable; clone allocates it only when source state has it. Outer-event preparation requires parameter, forcing, and state allocation when active and rejects those allocations when inactive.
findings.per_interval_compute: Snow evaluation is entered only in the snow_active branch.

findings.persistent_state: The physical-state component is allocatable; active admission requires its matching parameter and forcing controls. Parameter and interval-forcing buffers are allocated only in their active branches and deallocated before reconfiguration/preparation.
findings.per_interval_compute: Soil-temperature preparation/evaluation is guarded by soil_temperature_active.

findings.persistent_state: Distinct derived committed-state carriers represent the mutually exclusive active options. Their parameter and forcing components are allocatable; inactive admission requires both parameter allocations absent and runtime preparation rejects an attached inactive forcing component.
findings.per_interval_compute: Each process body is guarded by its active flag.

findings.persistent_state: Response-level parameters and response controls are allocatable and are copied only for an active response configuration. The qdra interval workspace is allocated for both the response and legacy drainage-flux routes, so it is not evidence of zero per-interval allocation for this option.
findings.per_interval_compute: Response preflight/evaluation requires drainage_response_active; inactive input uses the separate legacy drainage-flux matrix path.

findings.feature: bottom thermal and top sensible carriers
findings.persistent_state: Small carrier descriptors are embedded in the backend model and attempt context, but their sample payloads are allocatable. Transaction setup enables/initializes them only when the corresponding donor request is present; the bottom carrier is snapshotted and disabled immediately after the trial.
findings.per_interval_compute: Carrier append/materialization is request-gated; descriptor presence alone is not an allocated sample buffer.

findings.feature: root sink and drainage flux compatibility inputs
findings.persistent_state: These are forcing/work arrays, not committed optional process state. The serialized route validates and materializes per-interval arrays even when root extraction is inactive (inactive values must be zero); drainage qdra is allocated on both response and legacy-flux paths.
findings.per_interval_compute: The root sink is consumed by the admitted solver contract; inactive values are constrained to zero, but this census does not claim allocation-free handling.

findings.feature: macropore, hysteresis, tabulated hydraulics, elasticity, frost and other unadmitted physics
findings.persistent_state: Not represented by this admitted optional-state census; the current Reference production admission predicate rejects these active routes.
findings.per_interval_compute: No production runtime claim is made for rejected profiles.

result.static_evidence: For admitted snow, restricted soil temperature, Black/Boesten and drainage-response options, variable-size persistent optional payloads are represented by allocatable components and guarded active paths; inactive incompatible optional payloads fail closed. Request-gated thermal carrier payload buffers are allocatable.

bounded_state_clone_test.scope_note: Confirms base-state snapshots omit inactive snow/soil-temperature payloads and preserve explicitly present payloads when cloned; it does not execute the processes or measure bytes/CPU.

limitations: This is source inspection, not an executable active/inactive batch allocation or CPU census.
Per-interval root-sink, drainage-flux/qbot and related workspace arrays still allocate on the common route; no allocation-free inactive claim is made.
Some fixed-size descriptors and embedded process records exist in the backend regardless of active option; their exact per-column byte cost was not measured.
Unadmitted optional physics are excluded, not counted as zero-cost support.
result.next_action: Instrument representative active/inactive serialized batches for allocated payload bytes and option-specific calls, including common forcing/work arrays; retain the serial execution and physics policies.
